हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: For centuries, Princess Ishani has guarded Veerbhumi, cursed to lose her powers in every battle—awaiting her Divine Emperor. Her search ends when fate ties her to Arihant, an ordinary man with a fiery daughter. But as demons rise and his own brother turns against him, Arihant’s hidden destiny awakens. From betrayal to death itself, he rises to destroy the darkness, claim his crown, and unite with Ishani as the prophesied Divine Emperor.
